_comment: Apps that are not in the Arch repositories, installed from their maker's official release archive and kept up to date by riptide-session (archive_apps.py) – not by the app itself, and not by Flatpak. Each runs in our sandbox (sandbox.json) with its program folder read-only. repo: the GitHub project; asset: the release file for this computer; folder: the top folder inside it; program: what starts the app (inside that folder); icon: inside that folder; wm_class: the window's app id; policies: Firefox-style enterprise policies (distribution/policies.json); entry: the start entry's fields.
